CustomField.description: The type of the failure this event records: a fully qualified Apex exception class name (e.g., System.DmlException), or for entries logged from a Lightning web component, the JavaScript error name or the Apex type relayed from a failed server call.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The error type that was caught (e.g., System.DmlException, or a JavaScript error name for component entries). Filter by this field to find specific error types.
CustomField.label: Exception Type
